 Verizon tax refund approved in Bernards Township 
 By W. JACOB PERRY
Staff Writer 
 Nov 3, 2026 
 2 hrs ago

 BERNARDS TWP. - A corporate tax refund was among the items of business at the Township Committee meeting on Tuesday, Oct. 27.
 Under a resolution approved by the committee, Verizon, which has its operational headquarters off North Maple Avenue, received a property tax refund of $77,324 for the third and fourth quarters of 2026 due to an overpayment on property that had a reduction in value.
